decision.reason: The cited item [ev-18e2ad34cf67] is only a table-of-contents link to a procedure step. The matching section text [ev-c28095f20093] lists sub-step labels ("Add the Crossplane Helm repository", "Upgrade to Crossplane v2", "Verify the upgrade"), but the commands, chart versions and before/after values are missing. Nothing in the section says what changed in Crossplane core, which environments are exposed, or what happens if an operator does not do this step. The section mostly describes procedure for the migration ([ev-de978b4c1ed8], [ev-dd988a5ed5c3]). To type the change, we need the actual upgrade commands and version details, or the release-note text describing the core change.
